user.title: Elpris Forecast
user.description: Track the all-in hourly electricity price (spot + grid tariff + charges, incl. VAT) for a place in Denmark, with a 7-day forecast and learned uncertainty bands.

data_description.place: Four-digit postcode, dk1/dk2, or 'a' + grid area code (as accepted by elpriser.dk).

init.title: Error model
init.description: Changing the error-model settings re-fits it from the full stored history.

data.min_effective_n: Minimum effective sample size per horizon

data_description.agreement: productSlug from https://elpriser.dk/data/elpriser.json, e.g. 'supplier-product'. Adds the supplier's per-kWh markup to the shown prices (stored history and the error model stay markup-free). Spot-based (variable) agreements only.
data_description.forgetting_factor: Weight decay per newer residual in the same horizon. 0.95 = half-life of ~13.5 residuals (about a week).
data_description.min_scored_days: Distinct target days needed before a horizon gets its own learned band.
data_description.smoothing_hours: Neighbouring horizons pooled with a triangular kernel.
data_description.band_source: 'publisher': the forecast publisher's own (asymmetric) p10/p90. 'model': the learned Gaussian EWMA band. The other one is used where the preferred band is unavailable.
